Class FaissIndexBindings

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.vector.faiss.FaissIndexBindings
public final class FaissIndexBindings extends Object
FFM bindings for core FAISS Index operations (Index_c.h + index_factory_c.h).

Covers: index creation, train, add, search, range_search, assign, reset, remove_ids, reconstruct, compute_residual, sa_encode/decode, and property getters.

      Parameters:
      arena - memory arena for allocations
      dimension - vector dimension
      description - index description (e.g. "Flat", "HNSW32", "IVF100,Flat")
      metricType - metric type constant from FaissNative
      Returns:
